Semiconductors and airlines offer the clearest liquid momentum, but the large opening gap and the June 16-17 Fed meeting argue for pullback or opening-range confirmation rather than immediate chasing. The codex profile has no portfolio, observations, learned patterns, or effectiveness history yet, so confidence is deliberately moderate and active recommendations are limited to two.
